name: The Hall Brothers
caption: The NICW World Tag Team Champions of the fed's own 1999 revival, undefeated at 4-0-0 by the promotion's own April rankings.

tenures.source: Billed the NICW World Tag Team Champions (4-0-0) in the promotion's own "NICW Official Rankings" (21 April 1999); individual members' first names are not given.
